toegepas.blok: Ver weg, en tog die naaste ster
toegepas.voor: Dit is die rede waarom hy vir ons
toegepas.na: Dit is hoekom hy vir ons
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Dit is die rede waarom' is a stiff calque of 'that is the reason why'; 'Dit is hoekom' is shorter and more natural for Grade 4.
toegepas.fout: 'Dit is die rede waarom' is wordy and stiff for a Grade 4 reader, close to English 'that is the reason why'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Dit is hoekom' is the plain spoken form, same causal link back to the nearest-star sentence, nothing added or lost.

laat_vaar.na: 'n gewone sonbril gee nie sulke beskerming nie
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'bied dit nie' is formal and the pronoun is loose; naming the protection makes the safety point unmistakable without changing its scope.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: In the eye-safety passage the original is correct and clear: 'dit' can only refer to 'Sulke beskerming' earlier in the same sentence, 'bied beskerming' is the natural collocation, and the proposal only adds a third 'beskerming' in two sentences, so it is a lateral move in safety wording that should stay as it was checked.

vlae.teks: wat heeltemal uit baie warm gas bestaan
vlae.rede: 'baie warm gas' can be read as 'a lot of warm gas' rather than 'very hot gas'; left unchanged because the fix risks altering register or meaning, noted for the reviewer.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: hulle staan baie ver in die buiteruim
laat_vaar_vorige.na: hulle is baie ver weg in die buiteruim
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'staan baie ver' reads stiffly for distance; 'is baie ver weg' is the natural Afrikaans phrasing with the same meaning.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Staan' is the idiomatic Afrikaans verb for stars in the sky, so 'staan baie ver in die buiteruim' already reads naturally and the proposal is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Daar is dus nêrens op die Son 'n plek waar
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Daar is dus nêrens op die Son waar
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'nêrens' already means 'no place', so ''n plek' is redundant and makes the sentence wooden.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'nêrens ... 'n plek waar' is natural Afrikaans, and dropping 'n plek' leaves a looser construction rather than a clearly better one.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Stel jou voor die Son is hol en jy kan Aardes daarin gooi
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Stel jou voor dat die Son hol is en dat jy Aardes daarin kan gooi
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: After 'Stel jou voor' the imagined situation reads more correctly as 'dat'-clauses with the verb at the end.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Stel jou voor' with main-clause word order is correct, natural spoken Afrikaans; the dat-clauses only make the sentence longer for a Grade 4 reader.
